description: Atomic unit of swarm work. Director writes it; a worker claims and delivers it. Idempotent: identical inputs -> identical outputs.

acceptance_criteria.description: Checkable conditions for verified status. Each must be objectively testable.

budget_cap.description: Max spend for this packet. Worker stops and reports rather than exceeding.

deliverables.description: Exact output paths the worker must produce. Nothing else is accepted.

inputs.description: Everything the worker needs: storyboard excerpt, style pack refs, asset paths, seeds, frame ranges, prompts.

kit_version.description: Kit VERSION the packet was defined under, e.g. 0.1.0. Mismatch -> re-run, don't patch.

packet_kind.description: scene-code: write scene renderer. frames: render frame range. footage: gated AI plates. audio: VO/music/SFX. assembly: ffmpeg merge. qc: watch-skill pass.

scene_id.description: Storyboard scene this packet belongs to, e.g. sc03.

timeout_s.description: Worker silence beyond this -> director re-opens the packet.

title: One-Shot Video Kit — Work Packet
